title: Seongsu-dong flagships, bakeries and more: 14 spots
desc: Seoul's Seongsu-dong on one map: brand flagships and concept stores, cafés and bakeries, plus Seoul Forest and a taproom.

items.title: Common Ground (커먼그라운드)
items.memo: Three-level mall of painted shipping containers, open since 2015.

items.title: KWANGYA Seoul (광야)
items.memo: K-pop merch flagship in the SM Entertainment building basement.

items.title: Olive Young N Seongsu (올리브영N 성수)
items.memo: Five-floor, 12-zone beauty flagship with a cafe.

items.title: HAUS NOWHERE SEOUL (하우스 노웨어 서울)
items.memo: Opened Sept 2025: Gentle Monster store, rotating pop-ups and a cafe.

items.title: Blue Elephant Seongsu Flagship (블루엘리펀트 성수)
items.memo: Eyewear flagship from late 2025 with media art and a rooftop garden.

items.title: Musinsa Store Seongsu @ Daelim Changgo (무신사 스토어 성수)
items.memo: Musinsa's third shop, known for its sneaker wall.

items.title: LINE FRIENDS SQUARE Seongsu (라인프렌즈 스퀘어 성수)
items.memo: Brown and Cony goods; opened in 2024.

items.title: SEVY House (쎄비 하우스)
items.memo: Seven-floor knitting and craft store with lounge, cafe and rooftop.

items.title: Daelim Changgo (대림창고)
items.memo: Warehouse cafe-bakery with art installations and pop-up shows.

items.title: Cafe Onion Seongsu (카페어니언 성수)
items.memo: Rustic industrial cafe with pastries and a rooftop.

items.title: Jayeondo Sogeumppang Seongsu (자연도소금빵 성수)
items.memo: Four salt breads for 12,000 won; queues are normal.

items.title: Seoul Forest Park (서울숲)
items.memo: Big park with a deer corral, butterfly house and aerial walkway.

items.title: Seoul Brewery Seongsu (서울브루어리 성수)
items.memo: Taproom opened April 2023 in a minimalist space.
